## A plug is a promise. {#promise}

::: {.lede}
The lamp maker and the house builder never meet. They don't need to.
:::

::: {.sketch style="width: 1250px; margin-top: 1em;"}
```{=html}
{{< include /sketches/lamp-house.svg >}}
```
[house builder]{.label style="left: 23.3%; top: 91%;"}
[lamp maker]{.label style="left: 75.8%; top: 91%;"}
[the only thing they share]{.label .hand style="left: 39.5%; top: 66%;"}
:::

::: notes
Brisk — this is agreement, not argument.

A lamp maker doesn't ask which house you live in. They build to the plug. The builder doesn't ask what you'll plug in. Neither needs to know the other exists.

Keep it to one breath. The analogy works because it's obvious.
:::
